description: Architecture firms, engineering offices, construction companies, trade contractors, project developers
typical_workflows: Project acquisition: Tenders, competitions, direct contracts
Planning: Design, permit planning, execution planning
Cost estimation: Quantity takeoff, cost calculation, quotes
Billing: Measurements, invoice verification, change order management
common_pain_points: Creating tender texts: Specification items time-consuming to write
Quantity takeoff: Manual counting from drawings
Site documentation: Daily logs, defect photos
Change orders: Difficult justification and enforcement
Cost controlling: Actual vs. planned comparison is complex
Skilled labor shortage: Qualified planners and site managers lacking
ai_opportunities: Generate specification texts: Descriptions for tenders
Automatic quantity takeoff: AI reads drawings
Voice-based site diary: Dictate instead of type on site
Defect documentation: Photo → Automatic description and category
Code/Standards research: Quickly find relevant building codes
Schedule optimization: Analyze resources and dependencies
Change order drafting: Write legally sound justifications
